2.2.1.3. Certification_LCF_Dump.config.Config.filter_unused_primary_tables¶

property Config.filter_unused_primary_tables¶

If True (the default), unused primary table types will be filtered out from Types.lcf.

Set to False when it is important that all primary tables are presevered, e.g., the input lcf tables used by Prover iLock are trusted and are used directly for certification, and they may contain unused primary tables that require to be declared in Types.lcf.
